ms.promise:
Inspector Mobile Application (Flutter): A fully functional mobile application for PT Inspeksi Mobil Jogja's inspectors to conduct and submit digital reports from the field. This replaces their paper-based process. The application will be distributed through external download (all devices used by the inspectors are Android).
Internal Verification Dashboard (Web): A secure internal web dashboard for the PT Inspeksi Mobil Jogja team. This system allows for the review, management, and quality assurance of submitted inspection reports before they are committed to the blockchain.
Public Data Platform (Web): The public-facing website where end-users can search for and view the final, verified car inspection histories. This platform will feature a robust backend integrated with the Blockfrost API for on-chain data retrieval.
Blockfrost API Integration: Full integration with the Blockfrost API to anchor data (e.g., report hashes and metadata) onto the Cardano testnet. This approach replaces the initial plan for custom Plutus smart contracts, opting for a more mature, secure, and industry-standard method for this use case.
Comprehensive Documentation: Full technical documentation in Github a
ms.criteria:
Inspector Workflow: Inspectors can successfully log in, fill out, and submit inspection reports using the mobile application.
Internal Verification: The PT Inspeksi Mobil Jogja team can view, manage, and approve/reject submitted reports via the internal dashboard.
On-Chain Transaction: An approved report from the internal dashboard successfully triggers a transaction that immutably records the report's hash and key metadata on the Cardano testnet via the Blockfrost API.
Public Data Retrieval: The public-facing platform can successfully query the Cardano testnet (via Blockfrost) and accurately
